newsitem.title: HONG KONG: China's Ninghu Highway seeks HK$4 bln in HK float.
newsitem.headline: China's Ninghu Highway seeks HK$4 bln in HK float.

text.p: China's Ninghu Highway Co Ltd plans to raise about HK$4.0 billion by issuing one billion H-shares for a Hong Kong listing in the first half of the year, general manager Cai Jiafan said on Wednesday.
"Our target is a listing before the end of June," Cai told Reuters in a telephone interview.
Ninghu Highway, owned by the Communications Department of China's eastern province of Jiangsu, has appointed HSBC Investment Bank Asia Ltd as sponsor of the issue, Cai said.

The company's main asset is the 258 km-long Huning Highway connecting Shanghai and Ningjing. The highway opened in the last quarter of 1996, but Cai said revenues and other financial data were not yet available.

He said Ninghu Highway plans to issue between 25 and 30 percent of its enlarged share capital to Hong Kong and international investors through a Hong Kong initial public offering and global placement.
"But the proportions have not been finalised yet," he said.
Part of the proceeds would be used to buy Jiangsu National Highway 312 and participate in the development of other highway projects.
"A small portion will be used to repay loans," Cai said.
